after too many iterations.note: Asserts the 'Too many re-renders' limit for an unconditional render phase setState. The server renders the value a store was created with and doesn't re-render for store updates, so an unconditional store.update in render never loops (or throws) on the server. On the client it loops across renders, like updating another component in render (COPY_RULES).

using reducer passed at time of render,.note: Swaps the useReducer reducer between render phase re-renders. A store's reducer is fixed when the store is created, so there's no store analog. Same as the ReactHooksWithNoopRenderer skip.

with a warning for useRef inside useStat.note: Calls a Hook inside the useState initializer. A store's initial value is computed by the caller before createStore, outside of render, so there's no initializer for React to run under the nested Hooks dispatcher. Same as the ReactHooks 'warns when calling hooks inside useState's initialize function' skip.

warns when calling useRef inside useRedu.note: Asserts the server's 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render' error, which comes from the render phase re-render that runs the reducer. The server doesn't re-render for store updates: with no root reading the store, store.update runs the reducer right away to update the head, and nothing re-renders, so there's no hook count to compare. Same as the ReactHooks 'warns when calling hooks inside useReducer' skip.
